build_blip_grounding_model: build a BlipGrounding model with visual, text, and multimodal encoders for visual grounding
extract_image_features: extract image features from a batch of images using the visual encoder
compute_grounding_loss: compute grounding loss by fusing image and text features with box targets
predict_grounding_boxes: predict bounding boxes for given text descriptions on input images
forward_blip_grounding: run the BlipGrounding model in loss or predict mode with images and data samples
